So far talking with her wasn’t very productive. I mean… SHE CAN’T FUCKING TALK.
It won’t hurt to try again though.
You: Hey {f_botName}!
Bot: Hello master! My name is Jun. The sole purpose of my existence is to satisfy your sexual needs. 
What the hell?! She responded!
Bot: It looks like I have received a significant blunt trauma making me unresponsive for {f_Integer} minutes. I deeply apologize and hope that wasn’t an inconvenience to you.
Bot: Recovery process is almost finished, but it looks like some of the settings have been corrupted and lost. Would you be able to answer a few questions?
You: Y-yes.
I’m finally able to talk to her, but it feels weird and awkward. Maybe I’m just not good at talking...
Bot: I have automatically changed my language to “en-US” based on the data I’ve gathered. Is that okay?
You: Yes.
Bot: The default way of addressing you is “master”. Is that to your liking?
